info.title: Universal Scheduling Protocol (USP) REST API
info.description: The Universal Scheduling Protocol (USP) enables consumer platforms and AI agents to discover, check availability of, and book time-based services from businesses. This OpenAPI specification defines the REST binding for all USP operations.

tags.name: Availability
tags.description: Availability query and optional hold operations. Hold and release endpoints require the business to advertise holds: true in the dev.usp.services.availability capability.

USP-Agent.name: USP-Agent
USP-Agent.description: Platform profile URI for capability negotiation (Standalone Mode). RFC 8941 Dictionary Structured Field syntax. The business fetches this URI to determine the capability intersection. Required in Standalone Mode; omit in UCP-Native Mode.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID v4 for idempotency of state-modifying operations.

example.title: Bad Request
example.detail: Malformed JSON or missing required fields

Unauthorized.description: Protocol error: authentication required or signature verification failed. Signature error codes: signature_missing (no Signature/Signature-Input headers), signature_invalid (verification failed), key_not_found (keyid not in signer profile), digest_mismatch (Content-Digest does not match body), signature_expired (@created outside acceptable window).

value.title: Unauthorized
value.detail: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

value.title: Signature Missing
value.detail: Request does not include required Signature and Signature-Input headers

key_not_found.summary: Signing key not found in profile

value.title: Key Not Found
value.detail: The keyid in Signature-Input does not match any key in the signer's profile

value.title: Digest Mismatch
value.detail: Content-Digest header does not match the computed digest of the request body

value.title: Signature Expired
value.detail: The @created timestamp is outside the acceptable window

example.title: Not Found
example.detail: The requested resource does not exist

example.title: Conflict
example.detail: Idempotency key was previously used with different parameters

example.title: Forbidden
example.detail: The platform profile URL is not in the business's pre-approved allowlist

example.title: Failed Dependency
example.detail: Business profile could not be fetched

ServiceUnavailable.description: Service temporarily unavailable. The business is temporarily unable to handle requests.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying.

query.description: Free-text search query across service names, descriptions, and categories. When present, the business SHOULD rank results by relevance. Businesses that do not support search MUST ignore this field (not return an error). Aligns with UCP catalog_search.

filters.description: Filter criteria to narrow results. All specified filters combine with AND logic.

type.description: Service vertical to filter by (e.g., appointment, group, reservation).

category_id.description: Single category ID to filter by. Shorthand for categories with one value. If both category_id and categories are provided, categories takes precedence. Matches the primary categories[] entry's id, and MAY match any entry's id.

categories.description: Category IDs to filter by (OR logic - matches services in any listed category). Aligns with UCP catalog_search filters. Match rule: primary entry id, and MAY match any entry's id.

location_id.description: Location ID to filter by (for multi-location businesses).

price.description: Price range filter in minor currency units. Currency determined by context.currency or the business's default currency.

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units (e.g., 5000 = $50.00).

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units (e.g., 15000 = $150.00).

context.description: Buyer locale and intent signals for relevance, localization, and personalization. Aligns with UCP context pattern. Businesses SHOULD use context when available and MUST ignore unrecognized fields without error.

address_country.description: Buyer's country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g., US). Hint for market context.

address_region.description: Region within the country (e.g., California). Optional localization hint.

postal_code.description: Postal code (e.g., 94043). Optional regional refinement hint.

coordinates.description: Buyer's geographic coordinates for proximity-based ranking. Higher-resolution than postal code; location_id filter supersedes for multi-location businesses.

language.description: Preferred language (IETF BCP 47, e.g., en, fr-CA). Business MAY return content in a different language if unavailable.

currency.description: Preferred currency (ISO 4217, e.g., USD, EUR). Used as denomination for price filter values. Response prices include explicit currency.

intent.description: Free-text description of the buyer's intent (e.g., 'looking for a relaxing spa treatment'). Informs relevance and recommendations.

messages.description: Optional errors, warnings, or informational messages about the response (e.g., partial results, filter feedback, service-level notices).
Optional errors, warnings, or informational messages about the service (e.g., temporarily suspended, pricing provisional).

post.description: Returns full service objects for a batch of service IDs. Analogous to UCP catalog_lookup. Designed for hydrating multiple service references in a single request.

ids.description: Service IDs to look up. Businesses MUST accept at least 50 IDs. Duplicates are silently deduplicated.

context.description: Buyer locale and intent signals for localization of returned service content. Same definition as on POST /services/list. Businesses MUST ignore unrecognized fields without error.

coordinates.description: Buyer's geographic coordinates for proximity context.

language.description: Preferred language (IETF BCP 47, e.g., en, fr-CA).

200.description: Lookup results. May contain fewer services than requested IDs if some IDs were not found.

services.description: Services matching the requested IDs. May contain fewer items than requested if some IDs were not found. Unordered.

messages.description: Errors, warnings, or informational messages about the lookup (e.g., service_not_found for unresolved IDs).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous feed response's next_cursor field. Omit on the first request.

data.description: Full service object for updated state; object containing only id for deleted state.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass on the next request. Null when no more pages.

messages.description: Optional errors, warnings, or informational messages about the feed response (e.g., partial results due to degraded feed status).

post.description: Returns available time slots for a service within a date range. Platforms SHOULD query at most 7 calendar days per request. Businesses MAY reject wider ranges with HTTP 422 and error code range_too_wide. Slots are returned in ascending start order. See Section 9.1.2 of the specification for pagination semantics.

start_date.description: Start of range (RFC 3339 date or datetime).

end_date.description: End of range (RFC 3339 date or datetime).

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Defaults to business timezone.

resource_id.description: Preferred resource. If provided, only slots where this resource is available are returned.

party_size.description: Number of participants. For group/reservation types, only slots with sufficient remaining capacity are returned.

location_id.description: Location filter. Only slots at this location are returned. Applies to multi-location businesses.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US). When provided, the business SHOULD return human-readable content (resource names, slot labels, opening_hours day names) in the requested locale.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit on the first request. See Section 9.1.2 of the specification.

limit.description: Requested page size. Businesses MAY apply a lower or upper cap.

opening_hours.description: Regular business hours for the queried period. Special closures are reflected by the absence of slots, not by this field.

day_of_week.description: Days this entry applies to. Lowercase English day names: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday.

opens.description: Opening time in HH:MM 24-hour format (local business time).

closes.description: Closing time in HH:MM 24-hour format (local business time). 00:00 or 24:00 indicates midnight (end of day).

messages.description: Optional informational or warning messages about the result set (e.g., reduced availability due to staff absence, holiday hours in effect).

post.description: Creates a temporary hold on a time slot. Requires the business to advertise holds: true in the dev.usp.services.availability capability.

spots.description: Number of spots to hold. For group/reservation types.

201.description: Hold created or business outcome error

delete.description: Explicitly releases a hold before it expires. Requires the business to advertise holds: true in the dev.usp.services.availability capability.

hold_id.description: Hold ID from a prior hold operation. Present only when the business supports holds (holds: true on the availability capability). When provided, the business converts the hold to a booking.

recipient.description: The person receiving the service, when different from the buyer. When absent, the buyer is the recipient.

post_payment_return_request.description: Applicable when checkout_systems: redirect is in use. The platform SHOULD always include this field on the redirect checkout path — without it, the platform has no way to predict where the buyer will land after payment or cancellation.

recipient.description: The person receiving the service, when different from the buyer.

slot_id.description: The new slot to reschedule to.

hold_id.description: Hold ID for the new slot. Present only when the business supports holds (holds: true on the availability capability).

provider.description: Payment provider identifier (e.g. stripe, adyen, paypal). Informational.

transaction_id.description: Transaction identifier from the payment provider.

amount_paid.description: Amount paid in minor currency units.

order_reference.description: External order identifier from the checkout system.

slot_id.description: Specific slot to waitlist for, if applicable.

preferred_slots.description: Preferred time windows. If omitted, the buyer accepts any available slot.

service_id.description: Filter entries by service. If omitted, entries for all services are returned.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response for pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return. Default is implementation-defined.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Absent when no more results.

total.description: Total number of matching entries, if known.

hold_id.description: Hold ID for the offered slot, if already held.

profile_url.description: The business's /.well-known/usp or /.well-known/ucp profile URL. Must be reachable and return a valid profile.

description.description: Optional brief description of the business.

location.description: Physical location. Required when the business offers in_person or hybrid services.

schema.description: At least one of: location, verticals, categories, query, deployment_mode must be present (not only pagination and/or context).

deployment_mode.description: Filter by deployment mode. When omitted, returns both.

schema.description: At least one of: location, verticals, categories, query, price_range, duration_range must be present (not only pagination and/or context).

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units.

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units.

get.description: Returns the USP business profile document. Published at the well-known URI path. Platforms fetch this document to discover endpoints, negotiate capabilities, determine supported checkout systems, and obtain webhook verification keys. MUST be served over HTTPS with Cache-Control: public, max-age>=60 and no redirects.

Cache-Control.description: MUST include public and max-age>=60. Example: public, max-age=300

post.description: The business POSTs booking lifecycle events to the platform's registered webhook_url (Section 8.2.3). Payloads MUST be signed per Section 10.1.1. Not an endpoint the business exposes for inbound client calls — describes the shape of outbound POST requests from business to platform.
The business POSTs catalog change events to the platform webhook when using feed subscriptions. Payloads MUST be signed per Section 10.1.1.

The business POSTs waitlist lifecycle events to the platform's registered webhook_url (Section 8.2.3) when the dev.usp.services.waitlist capability is in use. Payloads MUST be signed per Section 10.1.1. Not an endpoint the business exposes for inbound client calls — describes the shape of outbound POST requests from business to platform.
